title: Grateful Dead Live at McNichols Sports Arena on 1981-07-13
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > R8Brain > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 05/2016
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > unknown lead deck > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell XLII's, FOB(?) recording by Brian Schley.

ai_review.summary: Fantastic audience recording of a relaxed yet inspired show with a thunder‑thick Fire transition and pitch‑corrected playback
ai_review.review: The audience capture is praised as outstanding, delivering clear ambience despite the venue’s poor acoustics; a pitch‑corrected version even fixes the usual half‑step speed issue. Musically the band is described as sweet, relaxed and inspired, highlighted by Phil Lesh’s “magic” on the fiery transition into Fire, though part of the first set is missing.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed, enthusiastic review gives high marks for performance and an excellent‑ish audience recording, tempered only by the missing portion of the first set.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Outstanding audience capture with clear ambience; pitch‑corrected to fix typical half‑step speed issue. First‑set segment is missing, limiting completeness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Relaxed yet inspired performance that leveraged McNichols' acoustics; strong second‑set energy with a thunderous transition into Fire.

band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for showing his magic fully during the transition into Fire.
